notes: A078128.A078128_conj: forall k, exists b, forall n > b, k < a n, with a n = number of Nat.Partition n with all parts k^3, k >= 2 (b = 216k+181 via a_lower: 216m+182 <= n -> m+1 <= a n, using m+1 partitions into 8s and 27s).
